rows.corpus_definition: to move slowly without control, carried by water or wind
rows.example_en: The small boat began to drift out to sea.

rows.corpus_definition: To fall in very small liquid drops.
rows.example_en: Water began to drip from the broken pipe.

rows.corpus_definition: A long period with no rain at all.
rows.example_en: The long drought killed all the farm crops.

rows.corpus_definition: To die from being under water for too long.
rows.example_en: The swimmer nearly did drown in the deep lake.

rows.corpus_definition: The state of having no trouble or difficulty.
rows.example_en: She passed the exam with great ease.

rows.corpus_definition: The sound that is sent back to your ears.
rows.example_en: My shout made a loud echo in the cave.

rows.corpus_definition: all the living things in an area and how they interact together
rows.example_en: Pollution is destroying the ocean ecosystem at an alarming rate.

rows.corpus_definition: Doing something well without wasting time or energy.
rows.example_en: She is a very efficient worker.

rows.corpus_definition: a process where people vote to choose who will lead the country
rows.example_en: The national election happens every four years.

rows.corpus_definition: graceful and stylish in appearance or manner
rows.example_en: She looked elegant in her long blue dress.
